name: tuck back lever
description: A face-down horizontal hold under a bar or rings with the knees pulled to the chest. It is the first static position of the back lever.
instructions: Hang from rings or a bar and roll back into a german hang with your knees tucked.
Raise your hips until your back is level with the floor.
Keep your arms locked straight and your knees close to your chest.
Press your hands down to keep your shoulders from rolling forward.
Hold, then return to the german hang and roll back down.
